title: Anna Is Sick
text:
Anna has a cold. She feels tired and her nose is red. She stays at home and drinks hot tea.

Her doctor says she needs rest for three days. Anna takes a pill every morning. After a week, she feels well again.

questions.text: How many days does the doctor say Anna needs rest?
How does Anna probably feel on the first day?
Why does Anna feel well again after a week?
options: The pills and rest helped her

vocabulary.definition: an illness that makes your nose run and makes you feel tired
having little energy and wanting to sleep or rest
a time when you stop working or moving to get your energy back
a small round medicine that you swallow

paragraph_translations: Anna ma przeziębienie. Czuje się zmęczona i jej nos jest czerwony. Zostaje w domu i pije gorącą herbatę.
Jej lekarz mówi, że potrzebuje odpoczynku przez trzy dni. Anna każdego ranka bierze tabletkę. Po tygodniu znowu czuje się dobrze.
